emails.subject: OVERDUE: Invoice #1198 from Pinegrove Logistics — 22 days past due
emails.body_plain:
Hi,

Following up on invoice #1198 ($18,420) for the March warehouse pallet runs. It's now 22 days past your NET-30, and we have not received payment or a response to our two prior notes.

Can you confirm receipt and provide a payment date by EOD Friday? We have a hard cap on AR before we have to pause services.

— Tom, Pinegrove Logistics

emails.subject: Re: OVERDUE: Invoice #1198 from Pinegrove Logistics — 22 days past due
emails.body_plain:
Adding to the thread — I've just heard from our GM that if we don't have a payment commitment by Friday COB, we'll need to formally pause the next shipment scheduled for April 22. That's the Boise route, which I know is critical for your retailer launch.

Please let me know today if you can.

— Tom

emails.subject: Heads up — supply chain delay on the SKU-7790 order
emails.body_plain:
Hi,

Wanted to flag a 4-5 day delay on the SKU-7790 order. The component supplier had a fire at one of their facilities. We're sourcing from a backup but it pushes the original April 18 delivery to roughly April 23.

We'll absorb the expedited freight cost. Please advise if this changes your downstream commitments — we can split the shipment if it would help.

— Karen, Arcane Supply

emails.subject: Re: Heads up — supply chain delay on the SKU-7790 order
emails.body_plain:
Quick update — backup supplier confirmed April 22 ship date (one day earlier than I originally estimated). Tracking will arrive via the usual route.

No further action needed on your end unless your retailer has specific delivery windows.

— Karen
